name: v1.131.0
body:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* **feat(api):** say how long to wait when glab api gets a 429 ([74182000](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/74182000)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **feat(attestation):** verify Sigstore attestations from any GitLab instance ([03623b1e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/03623b1e)) by Saahil Sabu Hameed<!--team-->   
* **feat(dependency-firewall):** add job-level proxy for CI jobs ([eb63d2f6](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/eb63d2f6)) by Ryan Wells<!--team-->   
* **feat(deploy-token):** Add --instance to list for instance-wide audits ([ee6bda02](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/ee6bda02)) by Pawel Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(df):** reach registries through proxies in Maven and Gradle settings ([499c5236](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/499c5236)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **feat(df):** reach registries through proxies set in package-manager config ([f0ff7383](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f0ff7383)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **feat(govern):** redact values under camelCase credential names ([95786324](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/95786324)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** sync Codex sessions from the Codex Stop hook ([6fe56080](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6fe56080)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(localization):** add Argo Translation YAML ([a3c12eca](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a3c12eca)) by Kevin Lew<!--team-->   
* **feat(mcp):** remove the experimental glab mcp command ([88f05f96](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/88f05f96)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **feat(minder):** record the folder of each transcript entry ([49c593f7](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/49c593f7)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(service-account):** Add service-account token command group ([37f6c17d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/37f6c17d)) by Pawel Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(todo):** show the group on group-scoped to-do items ([824d17e1](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/824d17e1)) by Rane Hebden<!--team-->   
* **feat(token):** store the rotated token after token rotate --self ([4dc88d8d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4dc88d8d)) by Rane Hebden<!--team-->   
* **feat(work-items):** add --status to work-items update ([2bc67717](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2bc67717)) by Rane Hebden<!--team-->   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* **fix(api):** redact tokens in GLAB_DEBUG_HTTP response dumps [1 of 6] ([efc6eff3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/efc6eff3)) by Andrew Jung<!--team-->   
* **fix(auth):** check the OAuth client ID against the token endpoint ([e32ba4e5](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e32ba4e5)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **fix(df):** evaluate nuget coordinates against the firewall API ([c5641326](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/c5641326)) by Rane Hebden<!--team-->   
* **fix(df):** present client_cert to an mTLS outbound proxy ([a61abd4a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a61abd4a)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **fix(df):** show the block reason where the package manager fails ([210bbd42](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/210bbd42)) by Hannah Baker<!--team-->   
* **fix(df):** trust ca_cert and package-manager CAs for glab df go module downloads ([dc123472](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/dc123472)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **fix(df):** trust the user's JVM truststore on Maven and Gradle registry connections ([7d5f75a3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7d5f75a3)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **fix(minder):** keep audit event requests under GitLab's 5 MB body limit ([70a4c15b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/70a4c15b)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **fix(minder):** report sessions started without a GitLab remote ([4d99be56](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4d99be56)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **fix(mr):** resolve the MR of a differently named local branch via tracking ([d3f8b51d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/d3f8b51d)) by Tomas Vik<!--team-->   
* **fix(mr-merge):** improve message about no pipeline having been run ([55ab1ffa](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/55ab1ffa)) by Ville Skyttä<!--community-->   
* **fix(orbit):** show install hint instead of stale help when binary is missing ([2b831dcf](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2b831dcf)) by Dmitry Gruzd<!--team-->   
* **fix(release):** warn when notes and notes-file are both provided ([b9b75518](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/b9b75518)) by Himanshu Jha<!--community-->   
* **fix(update):** skip post-upgrade banner in CI and when stderr is not a terminal ([91fdfe17](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/91fdfe17)) by Aanjaney Kumar Verma<!--team-->   
* **fix(utils):** use per-parser goldmark extension constructors ([627fc1b6](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/627fc1b6)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->   
* **fix(variable):** support scoped group updates and deletes ([ce1ff90c](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/ce1ff90c)) by Himanshu Jha<!--community-->   
### 📝 Documentation   
* **docs:** Fix comment to make more concise and correct ([3f54b8db](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/3f54b8db)) by Sam Roque-Worcel<!--team-->   
* **docs:** add reviewer and maintainer onboarding guide ([6f72f3f6](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6f72f3f6)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **docs:** update security release process to match current practice ([1a831787](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/1a831787)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
### 🔧 Maintenance   
* **chore(duo):** add review rule for keeping bundled skills in sync ([9d225409](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9d225409)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **chore(lint):** ignore testdata fixtures in markdownlint config ([596c99b7](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/596c99b7)) by Duo Developer<!--community-->   
* **ci:** gate release on unit and integration tests ([948a7c1b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/948a7c1b)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **ci:** key the Go cache on go.sum and .tool-versions ([a60e9e3f](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a60e9e3f)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **ci:** skip tests:coverage when a test job fails ([5f95db6a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/5f95db6a)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **refactor(commands):** use cobra.CompletionWithDesc more where appropriate ([cc347c6d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/cc347c6d)) by Ville Skyttä<!--community-->
